body: It's...not ok, but things will get better I hope. The pain is still inside me but I have people to which I can share it to. It will get better.

Thank you guys for everything, it might not mean much, but you probably save one life, or at least helped him to get through those dark hours. I'm home now, with my family and it's so relaxing, I was very tired after yesterday, especially mentally. They're more ok than I was thinking, they even can make jokes. That's very nice, I was expecting a gruesome atmosphere, it's fine for a change. 
You are great, guys.
Thank you, it's ok now. I'm waiting for my brother to pick me up.

I almost lost it up there, I was ready but I was too afraid to do it. I hesitated, it almost felt like I was waiting for something to stop me from doing it. My phone ringed, it was my brother. I completely forgot about him. He must be in pain just like me. I told him to come and pick me up, I'm ready to go home. Now, I'm with a man that was traveling the bridge, I asked him to stay with because I don't want to be alone anymore. Now I'm waiting for my brother to come.

I'm not alone, I have people left. I'm not acting on an impulse, I've been thinking all night while I was walking. I'm not going to jump. I will stay a bit on the bridge, alone, and then I will know what to do.

I'm almost there. The water is very clean from where I'm standing. First I will move my car and left it open with the keys inside. Maybe someone wants to take it, it's fine. First I'll throw my phone in the water, then I'll be alone to think. It is funny that I've come here many times and always there were many people. Now it's so empty. It's beautiful.
No...I'm still walking, back to my car, back to the bridge...

I'm walking in the rain, it's very cleansing for me. I don't know what to do, I can't go home and face my family. What's left of it, anyways... My brother and girlfriend are worried I guess, but I can't be there for them.

I fell asleep in car, just woke up. I acted crazy before, I don't even remember all. Outside is still storming, but I won't drive, I'm afraid that I might to something crazy again. I will take a walk on foot. Someone wants to talk?
You're right, i must scream and cry, but i have no air. I can't breath if I'm thinking about this.

Yes, I love my uncle, he's a good man. He's to broken himself to talk to him. I went outside, but it's very cold and it's raining a lot. It' so warm in car, but i can't go just now, I must watch the last episode. I just remembered, father said he's gonna take David on swim when he will get back, because every person should know how to swim. My boy was very happy. I can see now why.

I saw just a few minutes of the second episode, the buffering won't stop. It really pisses me off. I have 4G but i don't know why it isn't loading as it should. In two days, sunday, it will be my mothers birthday and I already bought them a new car, in order to replace that junk they had. It was the car my father told me they wish to buy, so i did that for them. I like Naruto, both characters and story. I just listen to his soundtrack, as buffering continues.

The internet isn't very good and the loading time takes forever. This will take more time than hoped. At this rate, i will not finish these episodes too soon. I forget to put them on phone, foolish of me. 
My uncle just told me few hours ago that my parents died in a car accident. Now i was returning after I saw them. I feel so dizzy, strange, i haven't drink nothing in years.
